0.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMECHAENTRYTICKETCOUNTER_00932_EXCHANGE_CONFIRM
0.description: It'll cost you <hex:022206E803FF022C03> <hex:02310CFF054974656D04E802030203> for a pilot application. What'll it be?

1.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMECHAENTRYTICKETCOUNTER_00932_NOT_ENOUGH_POINT
1.description: Sorry, but I'm gonna need <hex:022206E803FF022C03> <hex:02310CFF054974656D04E802030203> from you before I can get you a pilot application. Best of luck out there!

2.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMECHAENTRYTICKETCOUNTER_00932_FIRST_TALK
2.description: I manage the mechs and issue pilot applications to initiative collaborators. What do you need?

3.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMECHAENTRYTICKETCOUNTER_00932_TICKET_GET
3.description: Here you are, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Submit this application at the start of a mech op, and if you're lucky, you'll be selected for deployment!

4.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMECHAENTRYTICKETCOUNTER_00932_TICKET_GETED
4.description: You already have a pilot application, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! If you're ready to submit it, you can do so through your exotablet at the start of a mech op directive.

8.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMECHAENTRYTICKETCOUNTER_00932_TALK_CHOICES2
8.description: Travel to the ground support zone.

11.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMECHAENTRYTICKETCOUNTER_00932_TALK_SUPPORTER1
11.description: Ground supporters aid areas where mechs are deployed. You'll use specialized portable equipment to handle problems ill-suited to massive machinery.

12.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMECHAENTRYTICKETCOUNTER_00932_TALK_SUPPORTER2
12.description: During many operations, you'll find analytical devices called “field scanners” within the ground support zone.

13.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMECHAENTRYTICKETCOUNTER_00932_WARP_TALK1
13.description: This is not a drill─a mech op is underway! If you'd like to offer ground support, I'll send you at once!

14.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMECHAENTRYTICKETCOUNTER_00932_QUESTION
14.description: Travel to the ground support zone?

15.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMECHAENTRYTICKETCOUNTER_00932_WARP_TALK2
15.description: Eager, are we? Whenever the next mech op directive is issued, I'll be happy to send you.

16.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMECHAENTRYTICKETCOUNTER_00932_BEFORE_QUEST_TALK
16.description: New here, I take it? Have you spoken with Searchingway yet?

18.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMECHAENTRYTICKETCOUNTER_00932_TICKET_KINDS_TALK1
18.description: Before I issue a pilot application, I'll ask you to specify your desired operation site.

19.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMECHAENTRYTICKETCOUNTER_00932_TICKET_KINDS_TALK2
19.description: You'll need to pay using the local currency, too, so make sure you come prepared!

20.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMECHAENTRYTICKETCOUNTER_00932_BEFORE_QUEST_TALK_C1W2
20.description: Welcome to Phaenna! Have you spoken with Searchingway yet?

21.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMECHAENTRYTICKETCOUNTER_00932_BEFORE_QUEST_TALK_C1W3
21.description: Welcome to Oizys! I suggest you speak with Searchingway to learn about our operations here on the star.

22.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMECHAENTRYTICKETCOUNTER_00932_BEFORE_QUEST_TALK_C1W4
22.description: Welcome to Auxesia! Speak with Searchingway, and he'll explain our ongoing operations here.

23.name: TEXT_CTSWKSMECHAENTRYTICKETCOUNTER_00932_TALK_SUPPORTER3
23.description: Any materials gathered are to be submitted to these field scanners. Walk up to one, and it'll handle the rest.
